title: Spain's Geography
text:
Spain is a country in Europe. It is on the Iberian Peninsula. Madrid is the capital city. Spain has many mountains and rivers.

The Mediterranean Sea is on the east. The Atlantic Ocean is on the west. There are many beaches on the coast. People like to visit them in summer.

Why might people visit the beaches in summer?
options: Because there are no people there
Because the beaches are in the mountains

questions.text: What can we say about Spain's geography?
options: It has many different landforms and water

paragraph_translations: España es un país de Europa. Está en la península ibérica. Madrid es la ciudad capital. España tiene muchas montañas y ríos.
El mar Mediterráneo está al este. El océano Atlántico está al oeste. Hay muchas playas en la costa. A la gente le gusta visitarlas en verano.
